title: The Number Is Climbing
summary: On Day four, whatever rides the service elevator reaches floor 41.

beats.text: Day four. The numbers kept climbing. Thirty-eight. Thirty-nine. Forty.
I counted desks to stay calm. Forty-four.
It stopped on forty-one. A soft ding. The doors stayed shut.
Dev raised a finger. We knelt behind my model of the city.
The doors slid open a hand's width. Something tapped.
Then they opened fully. The car was empty, except for a ringing phone.
Ruth's desk phone, taped to the wall. Someone had carried it up.
"Them? They do not carry phones, Maya. Someone is playing with us."
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: Across the gap, in Calder Tower, a torch flashed three times.
The phone stopped ringing. Someone had answered it.
